nombre.message: Pantalay: draw, highlight and report bugs

descripcion.message: Draw on any web page, highlight your cursor and record bug reports with console and network logs for your Pantalay videos.

noPermitida.message: Chrome does not let extensions work on this page (Chrome pages and the Chrome Web Store). Open any website to use it.

reporteAyuda.message: Opens Pantalay to record. The console messages and network requests of this tab are attached to your video. Never passwords, cookies or what you send.

atajos.message: Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+A to draw, Alt+Shift+C for the cursor, Esc to stop drawing.
